description:
You are a Procurement Quality Manager at a furniture manufacturing company using Odoo 17 (http://localhost:8069, login: admin / admin). A recurring dimensional variance issue has been traced to supplier Batch A-2024-112 affecting Acoustic Bloc Screens. You must execute the following quality response:

1. Create a new quality alert team named "Supplier Nonconformance Review Board".
2. Create a new quality alert titled "Systematic Dimensional Variance - Supplier Batch A-2024-112" for the product "Acoustic Bloc Screens", with priority set to Urgent.
3. In that alert's Corrective Action field, enter: "Quarantine all remaining units from Batch A-2024-112. Issue formal NCR-2024-0847 to supplier. Conduct 100% inspection of quarantined stock using calibrated CMM equipment. Disposition: rework conforming units, scrap non-conforming units per procedure WI-QA-0122."
4. In that alert's Preventive Action field, enter: "Implement incoming inspection sampling plan per ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 Level II for all acoustic panel deliveries. Require supplier to submit dimensional inspection certificates with each shipment. Add supplier to enhanced surveillance program for minimum 6 months."
5. Find the existing quality alert "Material Hardness Below Specification" (currently in New stage) and move it to the In Progress stage.
6. Find the existing quality alert "Screen Frame Scratch on Delivery" and change its priority from Normal to Urgent.
